decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric draws on the firm's core weaving know-how, but its visibility fell from its own page to a mention, so its early results are weakening and it is a likely candidate for pruning when the next collection cycle comes.

The semi-transparent bouclé decorative fabric fits the firm's existing yarn-effect and sheer-fabric competence, and its steady mention across both years suggests it is still part of the collection, though not a lead item.

The flame-retardant jacquard builds on the firm's specialised contract-textile and certification knowledge, a lasting differentiator in the German market, and its continued page of its own signals sustained commitment.

The double-face wool-blend fabric is closely related to the firm's established weaving capabilities, but its low-key presence over two years suggests modest traction and some risk of being dropped from the collection.

The wool bouclé leno fabric extends the firm's existing sheer and leno know-how, but it is a niche, trend-driven decorative item with only a mention online, so it is vulnerable to a collection refresh.
The braided-structure fabric is the newest launch with a page of its own and uses related jacquard expertise, so the firm is still learning from its early results and will keep investing in it.
